subject: ShellPkg/TimeDate: Extract GetCurrentTime() helper
reasons: Function extraction: the pattern gRT->GetTime() + error-print + return is replaced by a call to a new GetCurrentTime() helper at 6 sites within one file

The repetitive call sites (6 occurrences) could theoretically be identified by Coccinelle, but the transformation requires introducing a new helper function which is beyond Coccinelle's transformation model
Coccinelle can match and rewrite call patterns but cannot introduce new function definitions or lift out shared error-handling into a new abstraction
